description: The base hoverbike ridden through its own vehicle graph (pd.vehicle_graph.v1; object-events slice 5 made every vehicle a graph vehicle and removed the native path beside it). The place is the one maian_vehicle_room_drive_smoke uses, where no mission can end the ride (B-1241): the Blank Room (dev-mods/blank_room) with a hoverbike that Forge's level document adds at boot (--debug-forge-level-vehicle), saved as the level 'Vehicle_Room' and played in a Combat Simulator match with no simulants. No mod vehicle and no model swap: the hoverbike keeps base:model_hovbike (modelnum 58) and base:vehicle_hoverbike's graph, 8 nodes and 5 execution edges. Player 0 is put on it (--debug-mount-bike: the mount request event.vehicle.mount_requested runs og.vehicle.mount_seat), accelerates for 1.4 s, steers right for 1.2 s, brakes for 1.4 s, holds the handbrake for 1.4 s (each long enough for the half-second input witness), then leaves it with the exit input (event.vehicle.dismount_requested runs og.vehicle.dismount_seat) and must be back on foot in walk mode. Exactly one mount and one dismount. It replaces, for this proof, vehicle_flow, which runs on Escape and cannot pass there: Escape starts in grab mode (B-1159, not a bug) and its script ends a ride a second after the vehicle moves (B-1241). Second thing it proves: a level authored before the lift and glass rules loads on slice 5. The saved level carries the Blank Room's graph (the pickup and door rules: 11 nodes, 7 execution edges, 4 modules), is not refused, and logs once that the game's own rules decide its lifts and glass.

input_sequence.comment: Boot makes the level (the Blank Room with a hoverbike that Forge's level document adds), the match starts on it with no simulants, and --debug-mount-bike puts Player 0 on the hoverbike as soon as the player walks. A match intro, if any, is skipped. The script waits here until the player has driven-seat control for a second.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_VEHICLE_EXIT
input_sequence.comment: Leave the vehicle: the dismount request goes to the graph, which runs the exit.
Player 0 is back on foot: walk mode, control, no vehicle layer on top.
Scripted exit after the ride and the dismount.
